metadata.title: Create Threshold Filter for Edge Detection

story.iWant: filter picks that meet the 5% EV threshold
story.soThat: only high-value recommendations are returned to the user
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Review architecture and data contracts (AC: #1-#2) * Load technical-spec.md Section 4 (Edge Detection Layer) to understand threshold filter purpose * Understand that this story consumes output from Story 5.1 (EVResult objects with ev_percentage field) * Understand the 5% threshold is business requirement (non-negotiable discipline) * Verify Story 5.1 (ev_calculator.py) exports filter_evs_by_threshold() that can be leveraged
- Task 2: Create PickCategory enum and utility models (AC: #7) * Create Pydantic enum: PickCategory with values: RECOMMENDED, MARGINAL, LOW, INVALID * Create Pydantic model: FilteredPick with fields for ev_result, category, category_reason, recommended * Add validation: category and recommended must be consistent
- Task 3: Implement core threshold filtering functions (AC: #2-#3, #6) * Function: filter_picks_by_threshold(ev_results, threshold_pct) → separates results * Function: categorize_picks(ev_results) → returns dict with RECOMMENDED/MARGINAL/LOW/INVALID * Enforce that no picks below threshold are returned as main output
- Task 4: Implement validation enforcement (AC: #6, #8) * Function: validate_threshold_enforcement(picks) → verifies all picks >= 5% * Function: verify_no_threshold_bypass(recommended_picks, all_picks) * Raise ValueError if any pick violates 5% threshold discipline
- Task 5: Implement no-picks messaging (AC: #5) * Function: no_picks_available_message(ev_results, threshold_pct) → structured message * Include summary of MARGINAL/LOW/INVALID counts * Suggest user actions for next steps
- Task 6: Implement batch filtering (AC: #9, #10) * Function: async apply_threshold_filter(fixtures, threshold_pct) → orchestrates filtering * Returns dict with recommended/marginal/low/invalid categorized picks * Logs filtering summary: total evaluated, breakdown by category
- Task 7: Implement integration with Story 5.1 (AC: #1-#3) * Verify filter_evs_by_threshold() from Story 5.1 can be imported and used * Export filter_picks_by_threshold from this module for downstream (Story 5.4) * Document dependency: "Requires Story 5.1 ev_calculator.py"
- Task 8: Create unit tests (AC: #2-#10) * Create /tests/unit/test_threshold_filter.py with comprehensive test cases * Test filter_picks_by_threshold() with valid/invalid/boundary cases * Test categorize_picks() - verify all 4 categories correct * Test validate_threshold_enforcement() - discipline violation detection * Test apply_threshold_filter() - batch processing * Target: minimum 85% code coverage
- Task 9: Create integration test with Story 5.1 (AC: #2-#3, #9-#10) * Create /tests/integration/test_threshold_filter_pipeline.py * Load sample fixtures with ev_results from Story 5.1 * Verify RECOMMENDED picks all >= 5% EV * Test "NO PICKS" scenario (all picks below threshold) * Test edge case: all picks exactly at threshold (5.0%)
- Task 10: Write module documentation (AC: #1) * Module docstring explaining purpose, 5% threshold, filtering categories * Document all functions: parameters, return types, examples * Document PickCategory enum values and usage * Add examples and discipline requirement notes

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Create `/src/bet_bot/analysis/edge/threshold_filter.py` module 2. Implement `def filter_picks_by_threshold(ev_results: list[EVResult], threshold_pct: float = 5.0) -> tuple[list[EVResult], list[EVResult]]` function that separates EV results into recommended (≥ threshold) and marginal (< threshold) 3. Implement `def categorize_picks(ev_results: list[EVResult]) -> dict[str, list[EVResult]]` that categorizes picks into RECOMMENDED (EV > 5%), MARGINAL (2% < EV < 5%), and LOW (EV < 2%) 4. Return only RECOMMENDED picks in main output; log MARGINAL picks for user reference 5. Return structured "NO PICKS AVAILABLE" message when zero RECOMMENDED picks found 6. Never lower the 5% threshold (discipline enforcement - this is non-negotiable) 7. Create `PickCategory` enum to standardize pick classifications (RECOMMENDED, MARGINAL, LOW, INVALID) 8. Implement `def validate_threshold_enforcement(picks: list[Pick]) -> bool` to verify no picks below threshold exist in output 9. Implement batch processing function: `async def apply_threshold_filter(fixtures: list[Fixture], threshold_pct: float = 5.0) -> dict[str, Any]` that orchestrates filtering and returns categorized picks 10. Log filtering summary: total picks evaluated, breakdown by category, picks removed by threshold

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: The Edge Detection Layer calculates expected value and filters for picks with EV > 5%. Purpose: Calculate expected value, filter for picks. Modules: ev_calculator.py (EV = (AI_prob × odds) - 1), threshold_filter.py (Filter for EV > 5%), confidence_scorer.py (Assess data quality reliability).

doc.title: Story 5.1: Implement Expected Value Calculation
doc.snippet: Story 5.1 provides EVResult objects with ev_percentage field and already exports filter_evs_by_threshold() helper function. EVResult has is_valid boolean and skip_reason for invalid calculations. Story 5.1 is marked as "review" status (DONE).

doc.title: bet-bot Development Stories
doc.snippet: Filter for picks with EV > 5% (0.05). Separate into: RECOMMENDED (EV > 5%), MARGINAL (2% < EV < 5%), LOW (EV < 2%). Return only RECOMMENDED picks in main output. Return "NO PICKS AVAILABLE" if zero RECOMMENDED picks found. Never lower threshold (discipline enforcement).

constraint.name: 5% Threshold Discipline
constraint.description: The 5% EV threshold is non-negotiable and represents the core discipline of the system. No picks below 5% EV should ever be recommended to the user in main output. This prevents emotional betting and overconfidence.

constraint.name: Graceful Degradation
constraint.description: Follow error handling patterns from Story 5.1: One EV calculation failure shouldn't block others. Use try/catch in batch processing, log and skip on failure, continue processing remaining fixtures.

constraint.name: Data Structure Convention
constraint.description: Always validate input before processing and return structured dict (not bare lists). Include status fields like has_picks, total_evaluated, no_picks_message in return dict.

constraint.name: Logging Standards
constraint.description: Use module-level logger, log at DEBUG/INFO/WARNING levels appropriately. Log progress "X of Y" during batch processing. Log filtering summary with counts and breakdown by category.

constraint.name: Pydantic v2 Only
constraint.description: Must use Pydantic v2 syntax: @field_validator (not @validator), ConfigDict (not Config class), populate_by_name (not allow_population_by_field_name). All models require explicit return type annotations.

constraint.name: Python 3.14+ Compatibility
constraint.description: Use datetime.now(timezone.utc) NOT datetime.utcnow(). Use modern type hints: list[X] not List[X], X | None not Optional[X]. All functions must have explicit return type annotations including -> None.

constraint.name: Integration with Story 5.1
constraint.description: Story 5.2 receives EVResult objects from Story 5.1 and can reuse filter_evs_by_threshold() helper. Output (RECOMMENDED picks) feeds into Story 5.3 (confidence_scorer) and Story 5.4 (edge_detection_pipeline).

interface.name: filter_picks_by_threshold
interface.signature: def filter_picks_by_threshold(ev_results: list[EVResult], threshold_pct: float = 5.0) -> tuple[list[EVResult], list[EVResult]]
interface.description: Separates EV results into recommended (≥ threshold) and marginal (< threshold). Validates threshold_pct is 0.0-100.0, returns tuple (above_threshold, below_threshold).

interface.name: categorize_picks
interface.description: Categorizes picks into RECOMMENDED (EV >= 5%), MARGINAL (2% <= EV < 5%), LOW (0% <= EV < 2%), INVALID (is_valid == False). Returns dict with category keys mapping to EVResult lists.

interface.name: apply_threshold_filter
interface.signature: async def apply_threshold_filter(fixtures: list[Fixture], threshold_pct: float = 5.0) -> dict[str, Any]
interface.description: Orchestrates filtering across multiple fixtures. Returns dict with: recommended[], marginal[], low[], invalid[], total_evaluated, total_recommended, threshold_pct, has_picks, no_picks_message. Logs progress and filtering summary.

interface.name: EVResult
interface.signature: EVResult(market_type: str, outcome: str, ai_probability: float, odds: float, implied_probability: float, ev_decimal: float, ev_percentage: float, is_valid: bool, skip_reason: str | None)
interface.description: Pydantic model representing single EV calculation. Contains market_type, outcome, ai_probability, odds, implied_probability, ev_decimal, ev_percentage, is_valid flag, and skip_reason for invalid calculations.

interface.name: Fixture
interface.signature: Fixture(fixture_id: str, kickoff_time: datetime, home_team: Team, away_team: Team, league: League, odds: dict, ai_analysis: AIAnalysis | None, ev_results: list[EVResult])
interface.description: Core data model. Story 5.1 adds ev_results field (populated by calculate_all_evs). Story 5.2 processes fixtures with populated ev_results. Story 5.3+ consumes filtered results.

tests.standards: Unit tests follow pytest conventions with fixtures, parametrize decorators, and assertions. Use Fixture factory from Story 5.1 tests as template. Mock EVResult data for unit tests. Integration tests use real Fixture structures from Story 5.1 integration test output. Target: minimum 85% code coverage (higher than Story 5.1 to show discipline enforcement). Error handling tests verify ValueError on threshold violations and discipline breaches.

tests.ideas: AC#2: Test filter_picks_by_threshold with valid EV 5.8% (above) and 4.2% (below); boundary at 5.0%; invalid threshold values AC#3: Test categorize_picks separates into RECOMMENDED/MARGINAL/LOW/INVALID correctly; verify all picks accounted for AC#5: Test no_picks_available_message returns non-empty string with MARGINAL/LOW/INVALID counts and suggestions AC#6: Test validate_threshold_enforcement raises ValueError if any pick < 5%; returns True for all >= 5% AC#7: Test PickCategory enum has 4 values: RECOMMENDED, MARGINAL, LOW, INVALID AC#8: Test verify_no_threshold_bypass detects if recommended_picks subset of all_picks with correct thresholds AC#9: Test apply_threshold_filter batch processes multiple fixtures; returns structured dict with all fields AC#10: Test filtering summary logging includes: total evaluated, category breakdown, threshold_pct Edge case: No picks result (all below threshold) → has_picks=False, no_picks_message populated Edge case: All picks exactly at 5.0% threshold (boundary) → all categorized as RECOMMENDED Edge case: Empty input list → returns empty dicts for each category
